newsitem.title: USA: Last minute April sweet crude barrels priced cheap.
newsitem.headline: Last minute April sweet crude barrels priced cheap.

text.p: Last minute deals for domestic crude barrels cheapened Tuesday morning on the final pipeline scheduling day for April, traders said.
Outright crude prices firmed slightly to put the active NYMEX contract, and corresponding cash price for May West Texas Intermediate/Cushing 20 cents firmer at $21.20-30 a barrel.
Traders said the April/May WTI spread, or roll, was talked at a positive 8-10 cts, putting April WTI at $21.30-40 a barrel, 35 cts higher than late Monday.
The roll started today's session at even to the marker.
